title: Claude Code — Intro Session | Talon.One
prompts: Claude Code: AI-powered coding assistant. Reads your codebase, edits files, runs commands, integrates with dev tools. Available on Terminal, VS Code, JetBrains, Desktop, Web, Chrome.
CLAUDE.md is the project config — tech stack, conventions, commands. CLAUDE.local.md is for personal overrides. Run /init to auto-generate.
Hooks are deterministic shell commands that run at lifecycle events: auto-format after edits, block protected files, send notifications, validate commands. Three types: command, prompt, agent.
MCP connects Claude to external tools. At Talon.One: Figma for designs, Shortcut for project tracking, Slack for team communication. 50+ integrations available.
Skills are reusable slash-command templates. Bundled: /batch, /simplify, /debug, /loop, /claude-api.
Custom skills: create SKILL.md with frontmatter for name, description, invocation control. Supports dynamic context injection, subagent execution, and file-scoped activation.
Sub-agents run in parallel: Explore for fast codebase search, Plan for architecture design, General Purpose for complex multi-step tasks.
Agent teams: multiple Claude instances coordinating via shared task list and direct messaging. Best for parallel review, competing hypotheses, cross-layer changes. Experimental, higher token cost.

Plugins bundle skills, agents, hooks, MCP, and LSP into shareable packages. Install from the official marketplace with /plugin install name@claude-plugins-official. Test locally with --plugin-dir. Browse with /plugin, hot-reload with /reload-plugins.
The extensibility spectrum: Configure (CLAUDE.md, Hooks) → Extend (MCP, Skills) → Orchestrate (Sub-agents, Agent Teams) → Share (Plugins). Start simple, escalate only when needed.
Chrome extension enables browser automation via MCP — navigate, click, fill forms, take screenshots, read console logs.
Thank you! Install: npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code. Docs: code.claude.com/docs. Run claude then /init to get started.
